changes: Document scanning now uses an on-device corner-detection model for receipts, colored paper, shadows and angled documents.
The live outline waits for stable corners, clears when the paper moves away, and resumes after returning to the app. Captured photos receive their own fresh detection.
The detector runs separately from the camera interface, loads only when scanning, and is cached for reuse. Retake, manual crop and protected originals remain available.
